description: This PHP source file defines the class MicrosoftOAuthProviderConnector, which extends ExternalOAuthProviderConnector to implement OAuth provider support for Microsoft, including methods for obtaining provider type, managing extra parameters, and mapping access tokens.

classes.name: MicrosoftOAuthProviderConnector
classes.description: A connector class for Microsoft's OAuth provider, extending the ExternalOAuthProviderConnector base class to implement specific OAuth logic for Microsoft.

methods.name: getProviderType
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for the provider type, which is 'Microsoft'.

methods.name: getExtraProviderParams
methods.description: Returns additional provider parameters, merging defaults with parent class's extra parameters.

methods.name: mapAccessToken
methods.description: Maps the AccessTokenInterface object to an associative array with keys such as 'access_token', 'expires_in', 'refresh_token', and 'token_type'.
